source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps location, sanctification, calling, and worldwide shared lordship.
key_decisions.before: To the church of God that is in Corinth, to people who have been made holy in Christ Jesus, called to be a holy people, together with everyone who in every place call upon the name of our Lord Jesus Christ—both their Lord and ours:
key_decisions.after: to God's church in Corinth, to those made holy in Christ Jesus and called to be saints, together with all who in every place call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ—their Lord and ours:
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: To the church of God that is in Corinth, to those who have been made holy in Christ Jesus, called to be a holy people, together with all who in every place call upon the name of our Lord Jesus Christ—both their Lord and ours:

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the appeal, divisions, and paired mental unity.
key_decisions.before: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you be in agreement, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be united in the same mind and the same purpose.
key_decisions.after: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be restored in the same mind and the same purpose.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you be in agreement, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be united in the same mind and the same purpose.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the three sharp rhetorical questions.
key_decisions.before: Has Christ been divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized in the name of Paul?
key_decisions.after: Has Christ been divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into Paul's name?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Has Christ been divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized in the name of Paul?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps commission, contrast, and emptied-cross image.
key_decisions.before: For Christ did not send me to baptize but to proclaim the good news—and not with wisdom of speech, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.
key_decisions.after: For Christ did not send me to baptize but to proclaim the good news—not with eloquent wisdom, so that Christ's cross would not be emptied of its power.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For Christ did not send me to baptize but to proclaim the good news—and not with wisdom of speech, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves present processes and the stark contrast.
key_decisions.before: For the word of the cross is foolishness to people who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
key_decisions.after: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is God's power.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the wisdom wordplay and divine pleasure.
key_decisions.before: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world did not know God through wisdom, God decided, through the foolishness of what is proclaimed, to save people who believe.
key_decisions.after: For since, in God's wisdom, the world did not know God through wisdom, God was pleased through the foolishness of what is proclaimed to save those who believe.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world did not know God through wisdom, God decided, through the foolishness of what is proclaimed, to save those who believe.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps crucifixion and both audience reactions.
